gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Non-strict mode returns the full encoded result without truncating to 6 characters.
ADDED i3: Strict mode (the default) truncates the result to at most 6 characters.
ADDED i4: The no-arg constructor creates a strict encoder (max 6-character output).
ADDED i5: Encoding an empty string leaves the encoder in strict mode.
ADDED i6: A null input is handled gracefully and does not alter the encoder's strict setting.
ADDED i7: encode(Object) throws an EncoderException when given a non-String argument.
ADDED i9: encode(Object) accepts a String argument and returns the NYSIIS code.
ADDED i10: Special characters are stripped before encoding; only letters influence the result.
ADDED i11: Mixed special characters and letters produce a correct NYSIIS code.
ADDED i12: Vowels, Z, and PH within a mixed input are transcoded per the NYSIIS rules.
ADDED i13: "kSCH": leading K->C and SCH->SSS collapse, trailing S is removed, yielding "C".
ADDED i14: A long input with special characters is correctly trimmed to 6-character strict output.
ADDED i15: Vowel sequences including 'H' and 'AU' combinations are handled by the H/W rules.
ADDED i16: encode(String) strips non-letter characters and applies all NYSIIS transcoding rules.
